activity.notes: Bayezid I (Yıldırım, 'the Thunderbolt') ruled the Ottoman state from 1389 until his defeat and capture by Timur at the Battle of Ankara in 1402. ATLAS reuses the existing Ottoman Empire polity and records only the closed sovereign reign interval.

sources.citation_text: The Cambridge article identifies Ottoman Sultan Bayezid I Yıldırım with reign dates 1389–1402 and places the end of his rule in the context of Timur's victory.
